notes: The expected NATIVE_SESSION_REVOCATION_IRREVERSIBLE SQLite error was deliberately provoked and caught.
A valid same-user device-B proof was rejected under device-A's session before nonce or last-seen mutation.
A backup captured while a synthetic session was active was restored after the row was removed; the restored credential was forced revoked and retained access material was rejected.

The final logical backup was parsed and restored twice; durable binding metadata, rotation history, revocation state and the version-policy snapshot were covered while raw codes and tokens were absent.
No real school identity, finance record, device or server was used.
